نتواصل (form VI)
# نَتَوَاصَلُ (natawāṣalu) /na.ta.waː.sˤa.lu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of تَوَاصَلَ (tawāṣala)
# نَتَوَاصَلَ (natawāṣala) /na.ta.waː.sˤa.la/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of تَوَاصَلَ (tawāṣala)
# نَتَوَاصَلْ (natawāṣal) /na.ta.waː.sˤal/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of تَوَاصَلَ (tawāṣala)
